title: 第5章 陪练第6章 群而攻之
content_zh:
今天，天还没亮，应无悔就被叫醒，他和一群人被炎门侍卫带领起来，去往训练场地。
所有人都面带惧色，而应无悔心里只有一些担心。
胖福半路被吓得尿裤子，一些之前陪练存活下来的人在祈祷，希望今年遇到的炎门弟子，能对自己下手轻一点，这里来的所有人都是炎门买来的奴隶，应无悔一眼就发现了，可是他们为什么要带上自己，自己是在还救命的恩情，姑且算欠他点医药费吧，但也不能这样对人，可这些侍卫腰间都佩戴大刀，且身形高大，还有可能会有异能，我们这种普通人根本不是对手，先忍忍看吧。
跟着两个炎门侍卫，走过蜿蜒的一条又一条山路，树林的叶子被风吹得沙沙抖动，太阳渐渐升了起来，应无悔和这些人被驱赶着前进，待卫门总觉得他们走的太慢，抽出皮鞭打过去，这些落在后面的人，基本上都是一些老弱病残，借这次训练，多半是要处理掉这些没有什么劳动价值的人。
来到训练场，这里视野宽阔，有一览众山小之姿，这是一个宽大的圆形场地，大概有十来个三四百米操场那么大。
这里有训练用的稻草人，从路口进来就看到了，还有一个露天的亭子，那里应该是个休息亭，在最边上的角落，有一个十分简陋的草棚，侍卫们把我们带到了那里，叫我们挨个进去，老实点。
“快一点，老东西，别浪费我们时间！”
“你们这些病死鬼，真是浪费炎门的资源，还不赶快滚进去”
侍卫们拿着皮鞭呵斥道。
没带过来的奴隶，没有一个人敢反驳，通通乖乖的跟小兔子一样进了笼子。
应无悔蹲坐在角落，旁边的胖福精神愰忽一直在颤抖，会忽然叫起来，应无悔安慰了很多遍都没有用，这里的人开始叽叽喳喳，这还是有一些力气的人，一些连力气都没有的人，他们就坐在地上，面色无光，身体瘦削，好像如随时会掉落的枯叶般。
时间一点一点的过去，黑暗中门被打开了，“都给我出来！”
侍卫们大声叫道。
奴隶们老老实实的就出去，应无悔跟在后面。
炎门弟子们意气风发，他们大步流星踏入训练场，脚部发出震地声，欢快地，开心地，一波又一波进入训练场，今天终究可以检验学堂的成果了。
学堂教的拳脚功夫再配合上异能的加成，事半功倍，一拳打断一棵树不是问题，每天都努力修行学习的焱子昂想着，今天还有各个科目的测试，综合成绩前十名者，都能拿到异能币和天材地宝草药的奖励，如果能拿到，练化吸收之后，能加速异能修练效率，使修行者更快突破等阶，当然排名越高肯定奖励越多，异能币的奖励，也可以买到很多帮助修炼的东西。
焱言大摇大摆地走在前面，身后跟着小师妹益萌，这次虽是普通训练，但也会排名次，这是学堂的测试，奖励虽然很少，但对于他们这种新手，诱惑力是很大的。
焱门本门弟子本身修行异能比他们早，焱言一眼望去觉得他们大多数是一级异能初阶，和自己这个高阶完全没法比，学弟学妹，就让学长好好给你们上一课。
焱梦葳和焱傅韩俩个，一走进训练场就有许多人和他们打招呼，他俩礼貌地予以回应。
“你们看那不是两个一等天赋的弟子吗？”

“真羡慕他们”
“对啊”
“这一次学堂测试前十一定有他的”
“那不是废诱吗，他们可是一等天赋”
其他炎门弟子们议论道。
“哟，梦葳师傅韩师弟，你们可真为炎门骄傲，两个都是一等天赋，祝贺你们啊”
content_en:
Today, before dawn, Ying Wuhui was woken up. He and a group of people were led by Yanmen guards to the training ground.
Everyone looked scared, but Ying Wuhui only had some worries in his heart.
Fat Fu was so frightened that he peed his pants. Some of the survivors of his previous sparring sessions were praying, hoping that the Yan Clan disciples they met this year would be gentler on him. Everyone here was a slave bought by the Yan Clan. Ying Wuhui discovered it at a glance, but why would they? By taking yourself with you, you are repaying the kindness of saving his life. Let's consider you owe him some medical expenses, but you can't treat people like this. However, these guards all wear swords at their waists, are tall, and may have supernatural powers. Ordinary people like us are no match at all, so just bear with them.
Following the two Flame Gate guards, they walked through winding mountain roads one after another. The leaves of the forest were rustled by the wind, and the sun gradually rose. Ying Wuhui and these people were driven forward. Waiting Gate always felt that they were walking too slowly, so he whipped them out. These people who were left behind were basically the old, weak, sick and disabled. Through this training, they were probably going to get rid of these people who had little labor value.
When we arrived at the training ground, we had a wide view, overlooking the mountains and small mountains. It was a large circular venue, about the size of a dozen three- or four-hundred-meter playgrounds.
There is a scarecrow for training here, which you can see as soon as you come in from the intersection. There is also an open-air pavilion, which should be a rest pavilion. In the far corner, there is a very simple straw shed. The guards took us there and told us to go in one by one and be honest.
"Hurry up, old guy, don't waste our time!"
"You sick damn ghosts are really wasting Yanmen's resources, why don't you get out of here quickly?"
The guards scolded him with leather whips.
None of the slaves who were not brought here dared to refute, and they all entered the cage obediently like little rabbits.
Ying Wuhui squatted in the corner. Fat Fu next to him suddenly kept trembling and would suddenly scream. Ying Wuhui comforted him many times to no avail. People here began to chatter. There were still some people who had some strength, and some who didn't even have any strength. They were sitting on the ground, their faces dull and their bodies thin, as if they were like dead leaves that would fall at any time.
Time passed little by little, and the door was opened in the darkness, "Everyone, come out!"
The guards shouted.
The slaves went out obediently, and Ying Wuhui followed behind.
The Yanmen disciples were high-spirited. They strode into the training ground with huge strides, their feet shaking the ground. They entered the training ground one after another happily and joyfully. Today they could finally test the achievements of the school.
The boxing and kicking skills taught in the school combined with the bonus of super powers can achieve twice the result with half the effort. It is not a problem to break a tree with one punch. Yan Ziang, who works hard to practice and study every day, thought that there will be tests in various subjects today, and those with the top ten comprehensive scores will all get super power coins. If you can get the rewards of heavenly materials and earthly treasures and herbs, after refining and absorbing them, you can speed up the efficiency of superpower training, allowing practitioners to break through levels faster. Of course, the higher the ranking, the more rewards you will get. You can also buy a lot of things to help with your training with the superpower coin rewards.
Yan Yan walked swaggering in front, followed by his junior sister Yimeng. Although this was an ordinary training, he would also be ranked. This was a test in the school. Although the rewards were small, for novices like them, the temptation was great.
The disciples of the Yan sect have practiced supernatural powers earlier than them. At a glance, Yan Yan feels that most of them are at the beginning of the first-level supernatural powers, which are completely incomparable with his high-level abilities. Juniors and juniors, let the seniors teach you a lesson.
As soon as Yan Mengwei and Yan Fuhan entered the training ground, many people greeted them, and they responded politely.
"Don't you think those are two first-class talented disciples?"
“I really envy them”
"Yeah"
"This time I learnedHe must be among the top ten in the test."
"Isn't that a waste of temptation? They are first-class talents."
The other Yanmen disciples discussed.
"Hey, Master Mengwei and Junior Brother Han, you are really proud of the Yan Clan. Both of them are first-class talents. Congratulations to you."
